assets.name: heavenward-environment
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original premium Chinese xianxia deckbuilding game's cinematic landscape background.
Primary request: Paint a moonlit Chinese mountain pass beneath a great luminous pale gold circular heavenly eclipse in the distant center-right. Misty jade mountains, a tiny ancient stone stair and path threading toward the eclipse, weathered black stone terrace across the foreground, elegant sharp silhouettes.
Style/medium: Exquisite high-end painterly fantasy game key art, elegant traditional Chinese landscape composition with rich restrained texture and strong readable silhouettes. Believable atmospheric depth.
Composition/framing: wide landscape 16:9. Keep the left third dark, quiet, low-detail negative space where game menus will later be overlaid. Eclipse is the striking focal point at the center-right in the upper middle distance. Entire foreground terrace visible.
Lighting/mood: majestic, mysterious, solemn moonlit atmosphere, fine pale gold rim light in deep mist.
Color palette: midnight green-black and deep blue, antique pale gold, warm ivory, extremely subtle cinnabar.
Constraints: environment only; no foreground people. No UI, no typography, no letters, no logos, no frame, no watermark.

assets.name: heavenward-techniques-atlas
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: an illustration atlas for the technique art in an original premium Chinese xianxia deckbuilding game.
Primary request: One perfectly square image divided into an EXACT 4 columns by 4 rows evenly spaced atlas of SIXTEEN equal square standalone mystical illustrations. All cells occupy precisely one quarter of canvas width and height. There are NO visible borders or gutters; cells meet edge-to-edge. Each vignette must be entirely contained in its own cell, centered with a generous dark margin, and no subject crosses the cell edge. Every focal subject is easily recognizable at 150 pixels wide.
Subjects in strict left-to-right row-major order:
Row 1: (1) a brilliant fire phoenix rising with swept wings, (2) a living flowering antler-shaped tree representing wood, (3) one rugged levitating mountain representing earth, (4) a luminous crescent-shaped ocean tide representing water.
Row 2: (5) a radiating fan of golden metal acupuncture needles, (6) a single luminous jade sword pointing diagonally upward, (7) an elegant white crane inside a spiral of wind, (8) a blood-red silk ribbon blade arcing through darkness.
Row 3: (9) a white spirit tiger emerging from pale mist, (10) a clenched bronze fist or gauntlet radiating strength, (11) a jade alchemical crucible glowing with refined essence, (12) a golden circular concentric formation seal of abstract lines without any written characters.
Row 4: (13) an unfurling celestial scroll lit by stars, (14) a simple steel sword crossed with a rough stone shield, (15) an immortal lotus with a falling meteor at its heart, (16) two divine cosmic hands gently holding a miniature sun.
Style/medium: Exquisite cohesive painterly Chinese fantasy game illustration, elegant sharp silhouettes, premium hand-painted material detail, warm luminous highlights against deep dark jade and midnight green-black backgrounds. Antique gold, ivory, jade, and restrained cinnabar. All sixteen cells share one coherent art direction.
Composition: square atlas, exactly 4 equal columns and 4 equal rows. Every cell is square. All subjects centered and isolated in their own space.
Constraints: Illustrations only. No card frames, no UI, no text, no numbers, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no borders, no gutters, no overview title. Do not merge subjects between cells.

assets.name: heavenward-characters-atlas
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a character portrait atlas for an original premium Chinese xianxia deckbuilding game.
Primary request: One landscape image in 3:2 aspect ratio, divided into EXACTLY 3 equal columns and 2 equal rows, creating SIX equal SQUARE portrait cells. No visible borders or gutters. Every head-and-shoulders portrait is centered, including full hair or headdress and visible shoulders, with dark space around its silhouette, entirely contained inside its square cell. Six distinct fictional fantasy characters in strict left-to-right row-major order:
Top row:
(1) young adult black-haired Chinese cultivator in flowing ivory robes, composed resolute gaze, refined handsome face, long hair neatly half-tied;
(2) dangerous masked bandit with a spear visible behind one shoulder, weathered dark armor and wrappings, strong angular silhouette;
(3) mysterious forest spirit with graceful white antlers, pale face, delicate jade and moss robes, quiet ageless expression.
Bottom row:
(4) cloud-void beastmaster with an elaborate raven headdress and storm-dark layered robes, hawklike gaze, wisps of cloud around shoulders;
(5) blood-link cultivator in red silk, striking elegant adult face, long dark hair and crimson ribbons, dangerous calm expression;
(6) restriction-soul oracle in purple-black, a fine veil across the lower face, elaborate dark crown, luminous violet eyes.
Style/medium: Exquisite cohesive painterly Chinese xianxia fantasy game art, sophisticated realistic adult faces and anatomy, detailed silk, lacquer, feathers, jade and metal, crisp readable silhouettes. Same visual world across every character.
Lighting/mood: restrained dramatic rim lighting, deep dark jade and midnight green-black backgrounds, antique pale gold and warm ivory highlights with individual crimson or violet accents.
Composition/framing: square head-and-shoulder portrait cells on a 3-column by 2-row atlas. No character or prop crosses its cell. Every face reads clearly at 150 pixels.
Constraints: no UI, no cards, no borders, no text, no characters or lettering, no numbers, no logos, no watermark. Exactly six portraits with consistent framing and scale.
